prose: PhreshOS is an operating system for software built with web technologies. It runs on the machine you install it on, keeps your programs running and gives you a browser desktop. Programs get one sign-in, storage, permissions and communication from the system, and everything on the desktop including the file manager is itself a program.
highlights: OS for web-tech programs with a browser desktop.
System provides sign-in, storage, permissions and messaging.
Even the file manager is a program.
